name: National Supportive Supervision Checklist Template
description: Full 148-question National Supportive Supervision Checklist for Health Facilities, Immunization Services, Cold Chain, AEFI, and Community Engagement.

questions.questionText: [13] Are routine EPI services being provided at this site?  *
[14] Provide a reason why a Routine EPI/Immunization is not being done at the site?  * Ask only if: “Are routine EPI services being provided at this site?” includes “No”
[15] Total number of all staff in the health facility Guidance: Please indicate the total number of all staff in the health facility (Medical, non-medical,administrative, management staff etc)
[16] Is there trained HF staff conducting RI?  *
[17] How many HF staff conducting RI are trained?  * Ask only if: “Is there trained HF staff conducting RI?” includes “Yes” Guidance: Enter zero or a positive number.
[18] Has HF staff received EPI training in last 2 years?  *
[19] Is there a copy of the National EPI field manual?  *
[20] Is there an updated HF RI micro-plan?  *
[21] Is the EPI target population known?  *

[22] What is the annual headcount estimate EPI target population?  * Ask only if: “Is the EPI target population known?” includes “Yes” Guidance: Use annual headcount under one population Enter zero or a positive number.
[23] Is a map of local catchment area displayed?  *
[24] How many Fixed Site sessions planned per month?  * Guidance: Enter zero or a positive number.
[25] How many Fixed Site sessions conducted last month?  * Guidance: Enter zero or a positive number.
[26] How many children were vaccinated for Penta 1 in the last 3 months for all strategies (Fixed, mobile, outreach session)?  * Guidance: Enter zero or a positive number.
[27] How many children were vaccinated for Penta 3 in the last 3 months for all strategies (Fixed, mobile, outreach session)?  * Guidance: Enter zero or a positive number.
[28] How many women vaccinated for TT (all doses) in the last Fixed Sessions?  * Guidance: Enter zero or a positive number.
[29] How many Mobile visits planned per month?  * Guidance: Enter zero or a positive number.
[30] How may Mobile visits conducted during the last month?  * Guidance: Enter zero or a positive number.
[31] How many Out-Reach visits planned per month?  * Guidance: Enter zero or a positive number.
[32] How many Out-Reach visits conducted last month?  * Guidance: Enter zero or a positive number.
[33] Were any immunization sessions cancelled during the previous month?  *
[34] If yes, why were the sessions cancelled?  * Ask only if: “Were any immunization sessions cancelled during the previous month?” includes “Yes”
[35] Are caregivers advised on when to return?  *
[36] Are you assessing Advocacy, Communication and Social Mobilization/Health Promotion?  *
[37] Does HF have a ACS plan?  *
[38] Is there a ACS plan for hard-to-reach (HTR) population?  *
[39] Are there active community health-related committees?  *
[40] Please provide names of the health related committees in your community  * Ask only if: “Are there active community health-related committees?” includes “Yes”

[41] How many meetings have been held in the past 3 months out of the total planned?  * Ask only if: “Are there active community health-related committees?” includes “Yes” Guidance: Allowed range: 0-3.
[42] Are there active community mobilizers?  *
[43] Does the Health Facility have IEC materials for routine immunization (observation)  *
[44] If yes, select what material is available (poster, leaflet, banner,)  * Ask only if: “Does the Health Facility have IEC materials for routine immunization (observation)” is “Yes”
[45] Is the HF using IEC material?  * Ask only if: “Does the Health Facility have IEC materials for routine immunization (observation)” is “Yes”
[46] If yes, please select how the material are being used.  * Ask only if: “Is the HF using IEC material?” is “Yes”
[47] Are you aware of the four tips/key messages for RI?  *
[48] If yes, please describe them.  * Ask only if: “Are you aware of the four tips/key messages for RI?” is “Yes”
[49] Did you use any of the four tips/key messages for RI with the last caregiver while providing immunization service?  *
[50] If yes, which messages did you use.  * Ask only if: “Did you use any of the four tips/key messages for RI with the last caregiver while providing immunization service?” is “Yes”
[51] Does the health facility have Child Health Record Book in stock?  *
[52] If yes, which version is available?  * Ask only if: “Does the health facility have Child Health Record Book in stock?” is “Yes”
[53] Does Health Facility conduct community engagement activities?  *
[54] If yes, how often do you conduct such community engagement activities  * Ask only if: “Does Health Facility conduct community engagement activities?” is “Yes”
[55] If Others (describe)  * Ask only if: “If yes, how often do you conduct such community engagement activities” is “e) Others (describe)”
[56] Interviewee  *
[57] Have your child/children been fully vaccinated or completed appropriate vaccination according to the age and schedule?  *

[58] Please provide the reasons for the delay or no vaccinations.  * Ask only if: “Have your child/children been fully vaccinated OR completed appropriate vaccination according to the age AND schedule?” is “c) Delay vaccination (missed doses)” OR “Have your child/children been fully vaccinated OR completed appropriate vaccination according to the age AND schedule?” is “d) No vaccination at all”
[59] If Others, specify  * Ask only if: “Please provide the reasons for the delay OR no vaccinations.” is “i) Other (specify)”
[60] Did you/caregiver have the Child Health Record Books (CHRB) to immunization (at home or clinic/vaccination sites)?  *
[61] If yes, what edition?  * Ask only if: “Did you/caregiver have the Child Health Record Books (CHRB) to immunization (at home OR clinic/vaccination sites)?” is “Yes”

[62] If not, why didn’t you have the Child Health Record Books (CHRB)?  * Ask only if: “Did you/caregiver have the Child Health Record Books (CHRB) to immunization (at home OR clinic/vaccination sites)?” is “No”
[63] If Others, specify  * Ask only if: “If not, why didn’t you have the Child Health Record Books (CHRB)?” is “d) Other (specify)”
[64] Where did you hear/learn about the benefits of immunization?  *
[65] If Others, specify  * Ask only if: “Where did you hear/learn about the benefits of immunization?” is “i) Other (specify)”
[66] Do you own a smart phone and internet access?  *
[67] Do you use a social media to access health information?  * Ask only if: “Do you own a smart phone AND internet access?” is “Yes”
[68] Do you remember seeing a post about routine immunization information online or on a mobile device over the past one week?  *
[69] Which social media do you usually use?  * Ask only if: “Do you own a smart phone AND internet access?” is “Yes”
[70] If Others, specify  * Ask only if: “Which social media do you usually use?” is “e) Other (specify)”

[97] Do you help health workers to mobilize your community for health/routine immunization?  *

[98] If yes, how often do you make community mobilization for health/routine immunization?  * Ask only if: “Do you help health workers to mobilize your community for health/routine immunization?” is “Yes”
[99] How do you hold community meetings /mobilization?  *
[100] If Others, specify  * Ask only if: “How do you hold community meetings /mobilization?” is “Other (specify)”
[101] Does the health facility have staff trained in AEFI?  *
[102] How many staff are trained in AEFI?  * Ask only if: “Does the health facility have staff trained in AEFI?” includes “Yes”
[103] Did the health facility record any AEFI?  *
[104] How many total number of MAJOR events were reported in the last 3 months  * Ask only if: “Did the health facility record any AEFI?” includes “Yes”
[105] How many total number of MINOR events were reported in the last 3 months  * Ask only if: “Did the health facility record any AEFI?” includes “Yes”
[106] Were the AEFI events reported?  * Ask only if: “Did the health facility record any AEFI?” includes “Yes”
[107] Is there a AEFI kit available with all supplies?  *
[108] If no, please indicate what is missing  * Ask only if: “Is there a AEFI kit available with all supplies?” includes “No”
[109] Is there an EPI register on site?  *
[110] Please take a photo of the register Ask only if: “Is there an EPI register on site?” includes “Yes”

[112] Are tally sheet & summary sheet available?  *
[113] Please select which data collection/reporting tools are missing in the health facility
[114] Stock register available?  *
[115] Is the HF sending monthly report to the district/province?  *
[116] Number of reports submitted in the past 3 months  * Ask only if: “Is the HF sending monthly report to the district/province?” includes “Yes” Guidance: Allowed range: 0-3.
[117] Is there an immunization monitoring chart available?  *
[118] Does the health facility use monitoring chart for RI performance?  * Ask only if: “Is there an immunization monitoring chart available?” includes “Yes”
[119] Please take a photo of the register Ask only if: “Is there an immunization monitoring chart available?” includes “Yes”
[120] Is there defaulter tracing mechanism?  *
[121] Is there a functioning coldchain equipment on site?  *
[122] If yes,what is the type of equipment is available on site?  * Ask only if: “Is there a functioning coldchain equipment on site?” includes “Yes”
[123] The equipment is powered by?  * Ask only if: “Is there a functioning coldchain equipment on site?” includes “Yes”
[124] Freezing storage capacity sufficient?  *
[125] Is the cold chain equipment placed in the best location with easy acces to the vaccines (not in direct sun,well ventilated) ?  *
[126] Does health facility have SOPs to guide when the coldchain equipment is malfunctional?  *
[127] Is there a Fridge Tag present?  *
[128] Please take a photo of the fridge tag  * Ask only if: “Is there a Fridge Tag present?” includes “Yes”
[129] Is the fridge Tag being used?  * Ask only if: “Is there a Fridge Tag present?” includes “Yes”
[130] Is the temperature chart recorded & displayed?  * Ask only if: “Is the fridge Tag being used?” includes “Yes”
[131] Please take a photo of the chart Ask only if: “Is the temperature chart recorded & displayed?” includes “Yes”
[132] What method is used for immunization medical waste disposal?  *
[133] If other method is used for immunization medical waste disposal, please specify.  * Ask only if: “What method is used for immunization medical waste disposal?” includes “Other”
[134] Are safety boxes used for sharp disposal?  *
[135] Please take a photo of the waste disposal site/facility  *
[136] Does HF use vaccine and supply stock ledger book or mSupply?  *
[137] Does Health Facility conduct vaccine forecasting, minimum & maximum & critical stocks?  *
[138] Is there adequate amount of vaccine and supplies for one month?  *
[139] Was there any stock out of vaccines and supplies during the last month?  *
[140] If yes, please list the stock out vaccines.  * Ask only if: “Was there any stock out of vaccines AND supplies during the last month?” includes “Yes”
[141] If yes, please list the stock out supplies.  * Ask only if: “Was there any stock out of vaccines AND supplies during the last month?” includes “Yes”
[142] Does the health facility monitor vaccine wastage rate?  *
[143] Is multi vial policy being observed?  *
[144] If No, please explain why  * Ask only if: “Is multi vial policy being observed?” includes “No”
[145] Is there any expired vaccine or supply in the HF?  *
[146] Please provide reasons for expiry of the commodities  * Ask only if: “Is there any expired vaccine OR supply in the HF?” includes “Yes”
[147] Do the health workers know how to read and interpret the VVM? Guidance: Ask them to describe VVM changes and what they mean
[148] Is there any vaccine with VVM unusable stage in the Refrigerator?  *
[149] Please provide reasons for the unusable VVM vaccines  * Ask only if: “Was there any stock out of vaccines AND supplies during the last month?” includes “Yes”
[150] Number of cold boxes available  * Guidance: Enter zero or a positive number.
[151] Number of vaccine carriers available  * Guidance: Enter zero or a positive number.
[152] Number of ice packs available  * Guidance: Enter zero or a positive number.
[153] When was the last supervisory visit to the HF by district or province?  *
[154] Did the visiting team make any recommnendations for the health facility team?  *

[155] Enter number of maximum number of recommendations made during the last visit  * Ask only if: “Did the visiting team make any recommnendations for the health facility team?” includes “Yes” Guidance: Maximum allowed: 5.
